visual: Broad glossy leathery leaves · pale midrib · upright single stem
water: Water when the top of the compost dries; less in winter
soilWarning: Bright indirect light · no cold draughts
prune: Prune in spring to control height; cut stems bleed white sap
toxicity: Milky sap is harmful if eaten and may irritate skin and eyes
hardinessNote: RHS H1b; indoors or under glass, roughly 10-15°C minimum
uncertain: PROVENANCE: this card was written by Claude from general horticultural knowledge at Oscar's request, NOT produced by the research pipeline that wrote every other card in the deck. It has not been checked against RHS or Kew.
Height and spread are INDOOR container figures. Ficus elastica reaches far greater size in the ground in its native range, and RHS quotes a much larger ultimate size for the species.
No cultivar is named. Most rubber plants in UK retail are named selections ('Robusta', 'Tineke', 'Abidjan', 'Melany'); which one this card represents is not recorded.
The 0-20 ratings are editorial judgements by Claude, not Oscar's, and pestRisk 8 in particular reflects scale insect being the usual problem on this plant.
